title: Neo4j Module Shell Rel Type Has
description: Neo4j graph migrations live as migrations.cypher in this ticket; migrate.neo4j.script.ts runs them. generate.script.ts exports only the live DB and does not run migrations.
summary: Renamed structural Module→Class|Interface|Scalar relationship from PART_OF to HAS in compose Neo4j SDL and migration Cypher (all [:PART_OF] sites). RelabelHasRelationshipsToOwns now excludes (Module)-[:HAS]->(Class|Interface|Scalar) so repeat migrate does not turn structural HAS into OWNS. Added RelabelLegacyPartOfStructuralEdgesToHas (MATCH on legacy PART_OF) for one-time upgrade from prior graphs. Renamed region RetypeResidualModuleOwnsToPartOf to RetypeResidualModuleOwnsToHas. Updated stitch-operation-command-migrations.script.ts reparent block comment. Attempted bun run test; nx build had not finished within the agent wait window.
